column3: NASB renders the singular “other” as the plural “others … they.”
Close to the Greek; NASB adds “out” to “choked.”
NASB follows the critical text with “ears” alone.
NASB adds “more” and recasts “will be abundant” as “he will have an abundance.”
NASB renders “in hearing you will hear” as “you will keep on hearing”; the quotation is in capitals.
Close to the Greek; the quotation is in capitals.
NASB renders “everyone hearing” as “when anyone hears” and adds “seed.”
NASB adds “firm” to “root” and “only” to “temporary”; “tribulation” is rendered “affliction.”
NASB follows the critical text with “the world” (literally “the age”) without “this”; “care” is rendered “worry.”
NASB supplies “Jesus” and renders “has become like” as “may be compared to.”
NASB renders “the plants” as “the wheat” and “fruit” as “grain.”
NASB renders “servants” (douloi) as “slaves” and “master of the house” as “landowner.”
NASB renders “harvesters” as “reapers” and adds “up” to “burn.”
